name: Linked Senses (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 8

Benefit: A saboteur with this trick can see through the eyes and ears of her marked target. She can attempt to look through the senses of a creature marked with her informant’s mark, as if using the spell witness. The creature gains a saving throw to negate this effect; the DC is equal to her saboteur trick DC, rather than the spell’s normal DC. The saboteur can use this ability a number of minutes per day equal to her Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); this duration does not have to be consecutive, but must be spent in 1-minute increments.
